{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a copy to work with
df = trial_df.copy()

# Identify patients with sentinel value -999.0 in baseline
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Check the distribution of these patients across arms
print('Distribution of sentinel value patients by arm:')
print(df[sentinel_mask]['arm'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check distribution by severity
print('Distribution of sentinel value patients by severity:')
print(df[sentinel_mask]['severity'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check distribution by sex
print('Distribution of sentinel value patients by sex:')
print(df[sentinel_mask]['sex'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check distribution by assay_batch
print('Distribution of sentinel value patients by assay_batch:')
print(df[sentinel_mask]['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
